title: Tim Dooley Statements — Conversation Recovery Wave 002
purpose: Preserve compact North and relationship-first formulations recovered after the main 2026-09-10 statement pass, without pretending later archive synthesis is an earlier Tim quotation.
provenance_rule: These formulations are preserved from user-originated prior-project context. They remain conversation/project evidence until a dated public primary source is located.

statements.meaning: North is not only a compass direction or bloc label; in the project method it is a relational structure composed of connections, dependencies, routes, capabilities and shared orientation.

statements.wording: Don’t map Denmark. Map Denmark’s relationships.
statements.meaning: A country is inadequately represented as an isolated node; the useful object is Denmark together with ownership, trade, finance, infrastructure, institutions, culture, energy, security, dependencies and bilateral/multilateral edges.

paraphrased_context.statement: In the later North framing, Britain's strategically relevant relation was repeatedly considered through Europe/North rather than by automatically treating Britain as an extension of the United States.
paraphrased_context.recovery_need: Locate exact Tim wording and date before quoting this as a statement.
